# Ads $0
nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={})
print("WK48 config applied.")

import json
ov = nm.market.get_market_overview()
print("capacity tier check via cost_info:")

for row in r['rows']: print(f"  {row['plan']} promo${row['promotion']:.0f} eff${row['effective_price']:.0f}: {row['n']:,}")
